notes: Both tools are registered unconditionally in `list_tools` (server.py:128-180), so both are default-enabled.
The only inputs are timezone names and an HH:MM string; invalid values raise `McpError`/`ValueError` (server.py:53-57, 215-216). No sink, secret, or exec surface exists in this server.

convert_time.rationale: `convert_time` parses the time string with `strptime` and converts via `astimezone`; purely local computation with no outbound request, no file read, and no execution path.

get_current_time.rationale: `get_current_time` only calls `ZoneInfo` and `datetime.now` and returns timezone/date fields; no file, network, or command access. Local time/timezone is not meaningfully non-public data and no attacker-controlled content enters the result.

value_conditions.effect: Only changes the timezone string embedded in tool descriptions; does not add or remove any capability or label.
